profile.headline: Software Engineer at YNAB
profile.summary:
With more than 9 years of experience as a full stack web developer I'm always looking for a big challenge.

My back end experience is mostly in .NET with SQL server, from old school web forms to the latest ASP MVC version, from plain stored procedures to ORMs like Entity Framework and NHibernate. As a tech lead I've been in charge of a new website's architecture in a 10 people team, while also coaching Jr. developers.

On the front end, my work in enterprise applications and public facing websites make me more than familiar with frameworks like jQuery, Angular and plain Javascript. The last two years my interest and skills on Javascript have grown considerably and I've been able to deliver work that I'm proud of, from shopping carts to SPAs for geographic visualizations and family tree building. I'm actively learning about new web technologies like React and NodeJS.

On GitHub, the projects CsBuilder and SpecPattern reflect my design and programming style, a strong object oriented design with a declarative style.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Houston y alrededores, Texas, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Responsible of the development of the redesigned FamilyTreeDNA website.

My first major task was the development of a new shopping cart from database schema to front end Javascript. The shopping cart is built with AngularJS, RequireJS, HTML5, CSS3 with a ASP WebAPI backend that uses Entity Framework for database access.

After a successful release I started working on the myOrigins webpage, a page that allows to visualize a person's ancestral origins through an interactive map built with jQuery, Mapbox, leafletJS, and ASP MVC. The page makes heavy use of Javascript to provide an excellent user experience.

After this two releases a major challenge I faced was to develop a page in which a customer can build a full family tree from scratch or uploading it from a flat file. The design requirements involved many challenges such as zoom in/out, panning box, inline editing, ability to load trees with thousands of nodes, public sharing, support of edge cases such as half siblings, multiple spouses, inbreeding, etc. The page was a big success since it was built in 4 months with a better experience than the options offered by all our competitors.

Other tasks in my current jobs involve SQL Server optimization (queries involving tables with millions of rows), process integration with RabbitMQ, administration pages to manage genetic information input using AngularJS, unit testing using Rhino Mocks and Moq.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Houston y alrededores, Texas, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Analyze, design and development of business applications built in Microsoft technologies.

Avanade is a joint venture of Microsoft and Accenture that specializes in enterprise applications built in Microsoft technologies.

Accomplishments: Worked in projects for major oil and gas companies being responsible of ASP MVC application development, SQL Server development, queries optimization, code changes and business analysis. Obtained certifications in both .NET and SQL Server technologies during training time.

Worked on performance improvement and a complete architecture redesign and implementation of an ASP MVC application to help the project go live in 2 months. Our stack consisted in C#, ASP .NET MVC, SQL Server, HTML5, CSS3, Entity Framework, JQuery.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
Architectural decisions, design and development of intranet.

Accomplishments: Design and development of a core module in an application to create and compile code to be integrated into the application and its ORM dynamically. Design and development of Specification Pattern implementation in C# using IQueryable to integrate to database with code only (See https://github.com/jorgehmv/SpecPattern). Design and development of DSL to create C# code heavily based in lambda expressions usage (See https://github.com/jorgehmv/CsBuilder).

Worked heavily with JQuery based pages, using jQGrid, KnockoutJS, custom jQuery plugins, Ajax, integration with Facebook and Twitter APIs.

Lead development team of 8 developers, using agile concepts, continuous integration using Cruise Control .NET, nUnit and Visual Studio Database Projects.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.locationName: Albany y alrededores, Nueva York , Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Design and development of The Wercs Studio web site.

Accomplishments: Remote work position, working one month on site on the client's office at Albany, NY, achieving a refactoring in the localization approach to dramatically improve performance of the application.

Maintenance of a WYSIWYG application built in Windows Forms with heavy use of Graphics libraries for diagrams creation.

Worked with product bug fixing in several branches with regular production deploys.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
Design and development of Quantuvis Online web site.

Accomplishments: Quick learning of the ASP MVC framework, a brand new technology at the time. Development of full data-driven module to create custom surveys supporting many types of questions(single choice, multiple choice, dropdowns, etc). Successful use of unit testing for financial calculations, product released to production. SCRUM methodology with a remote Dev and QA team.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
Analysis, design and development of Banorte Fiduciario intranet.

Accomplishments: Great professional growth (from internship to senior developer on 2 years), fundamental part of project not only as a developer but as full responsible person of Investments module, in charge of several backend processes and its architecture, frequent contact with high level clients, high business understanding, product on production.
